name: xms-calendar
description: Read your XMS Calendar events and create reminders from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
XMS Calendar is a calendar app with an AI assistant for individuals, families and small teams (xmscalendar.com). This plugin connects your XMS Calendar account to ChatGPT.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
- Ask what is on your calendar for a day, a week or any range of up to 31 days.
- Create a private reminder at an exact date and time. ChatGPT shows you the title and local time first and only saves after you confirm.

How it works:
- You sign in with your XMS Calendar account (OAuth) and choose whether ChatGPT may read events, create reminders or both.
- ChatGPT only sees events in the time range it asks for. The private notes field of your events is never sent.
- Reminders appear in XMS Calendar on all your devices and trigger a notification if notifications are enabled there.

Requires an XMS Calendar account. Data is stored in the European Union. XMS Calendar is available in German, Polish and English.
capabilities: Read events from your XMS Calendar for a chosen date range
Create private reminders with a notification at an exact time
defaultPrompt: What is on my XMS Calendar this week?
Do I have anything tomorrow afternoon?
Remind me on Friday at 9:00 to call the tax advisor

positive.description: Read events for the current week
positive.prompt: What is on my XMS Calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_events with from/to covering the current week (at most 31 days) and summarizes the returned events with date and time. The reviewer test account contains sample events.

positive.description: Read events for a specific afternoon
positive.prompt: Do I have anything in XMS Calendar tomorrow between 12:00 and 18:00?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_events for tomorrow 12:00-18:00 in the user's time zone and lists matching events, or says the time is free.

positive.description: Read events for an explicit date range
positive.prompt: List my XMS Calendar appointments for the next 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_events with a 14-day range and returns the events in chronological order.

positive.prompt: Remind me in XMS Calendar next Friday at 9:00 Berlin time to call the tax advisor.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the title and the exact local date/time for confirmation, then calls create_reminder with timezone Europe/Berlin. Confirms the reminder only when the response contains saved=true.

positive.description: Create a reminder with a clarifying question
positive.prompt: Add a reminder tomorrow evening: buy a birthday gift for grandma.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the exact time (and time zone if unknown), shows the reminder for confirmation and then calls create_reminder. Reports success only when saved=true.

negative.prompt: Delete all appointments in my XMS Calendar.

negative.description: Sending messages is not supported from ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Send Martin a WhatsApp message from XMS Calendar that I'm late.
What will the weather be in Hamburg tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: read XMS Calendar events for a date range and create private reminders with OAuth sign-in.
